sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "North Inner City" (cons 191). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Six, the area where Tony Gregory, the one candidate on file, was elected (IrelandElection.com, Area No. 6; Irish Independent, 9 June 1979, p. 5), filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
